reason: This is a broad refactor in core executor/distsql infrastructure, not a narrow cleanup. It touches central runtime paths (`table_reader`, `point_get`, `batch_point_get`, `index_merge_reader`, `mpp_gather`, `analyze_col_v2`), plus `builder`, `executor.go`, `distsql` context/result handling, and even `session`/`sessionctx` interfaces. A change to the base executor shape or lifecycle can silently break required-rows handling, row retrieval semantics, context propagation, or distributed read execution across many query types. The blast radius is high enough to justify a focused deep review for Blocker/High executor-runtime correctness issues.
